name: Julia Fletcher
bio:
Julia Fletcher is an American voice and theater actress best known for her extensive voice-over work in iconic video games, anime and animated films. She has built a prolific career spanning over three decades across both vocal booths and live stage performances.

She comes from a highly artistic family and has been married to fellow voice actor John DeMita since 1992. She is the sister of voice director Jack Fletcher and the mother of actors Conner DeMita and Elliot Fletcher.
